A hand-rolled converter drops every widget value silently. A CACHED run writes NO file, so an empty output diff means 'no change', not 'failed'.
python reading any repo JSON needs explicit encoding='utf-8' - cp1252 is the default here.
Bash tool: no heredocs and no backslash-continuations (guard-shell blocks both; backslashes are halved). Write scripts with the Write tool and run them by path.
